tool_routing: Low-level orchestration framework: StateGraph with nodes, edges, START/END
Tool integration via LangChain components: models, tools, agent loops on top of LangGraph
Deep Agents SDK: planning, subagents, filesystem tools, and context management on top of LangGraph
State-based: graph state passed between nodes, typed via TypedDict with reducers
memory_system: Short-term: state persisted via checkpointer at each super-step boundary
Long-term: stores with custom namespaces, shared across threads
Three memory types: semantic (facts), episodic (experiences), procedural (instructions)
Profile vs Collection patterns: single JSON profile or document collection for memories
session_mgmt: Thread-based session model: thread_id as primary key for checkpoint storage
Human-in-the-loop: inspect, interrupt, approve graph steps at any point
Time travel: replay prior executions, fork state at arbitrary checkpoints
Thread organizes multiple interactions in a session (like email threads)
context_mgmt: Context window management via message filtering: trim/filter conversation history
Auto-compaction not built-in — manual message management techniques
Agent state includes conversation history + files + retrieved documents + artifacts
security_model: Durable execution: checkpoint persistence for fault tolerance
Pending writes: failed nodes don't require recomputing successful node writes
Human-in-the-loop is core security pattern — manual approval at graph steps
CLI_UX: Python library, not terminal CLI — pip install langgraph
LangSmith CLI for tracing, datasets, experiments
LangSmith Studio: visual interface for designing and testing agents
mcp_protocol: No native MCP support mentioned — uses LangChain's own tool integration system
execution_model: StateGraph orchestration: nodes execute (potentially in parallel) per super-step
Agent Server for production deployment with automatic checkpointing
Subgraph support: nested graphs with own state and checkpoints
Fault-tolerant: resume from last successful super-step after failure
